This page lists the Stata DO and ADO files retained in `scripts/stata/` as at 7 August 2026. It separates routine operational code from validation evidence and legacy code awaiting controlled retirement. Detailed run instructions belong in `site/operations/` and `site/technical/`.

The **Stata dependencies** column lists other DO or ADO files required by the file. It does not list input datasets, manifests, dialog files, help files, or standard Stata commands. A dependency marked *indirect* is called through another listed helper.

## Active operational code

These files form the current Metrics, Briefings and Tables workflows. They should remain in the live code tree.

| Area | File | Responsibility | Stata dependencies |
|:-----|:-----|:---------------|:-------------------|
| ADO utility | [`ado/bnr_workbook.ado`](ado/bnr_workbook.ado) | Creates an Excel workbook from a Stata dataset, with separate data, dataset-metadata and variable-metadata worksheets. | None. |
| ADO utility | [`ado/bnr_yml.ado`](ado/bnr_yml.ado) | Creates standard BNR dataset-metadata YAML from Stata dataset notes, labels, formats, types and observed labelled categories. | None. |
| Briefing Step 1 | [`briefings/bnr_step1_build_briefing.do`](briefings/bnr_step1_build_briefing.do) | Dispatches a briefing build request to the selected analyst-owned analysis file. It makes no analytical decisions and creates no outputs itself. | `cvd_incidence.do`; `cvd_case_fatality.do`; `cvd_length_of_stay.do`. |
| Briefing Step 2 | [`briefings/bnr_step2_approve_briefing.do`](briefings/bnr_step2_approve_briefing.do) | Validates a staged briefing package, records the reviewer decision and creates the approval receipt and public manifest. It does not publish files. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Briefing Step 3 | [`briefings/bnr_step3_publish_briefing.do`](briefings/bnr_step3_publish_briefing.do) | Validates the approval receipt and public manifest, promotes approved briefing files to `outputs/public/briefings/`, and refreshes the site download mirror. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Briefing analysis | [`briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality.do`](briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality.do) | Calculates annual CVD case-fatality outputs from the approved Step 3 metric-input dataset and creates a complete private staging package for review. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly `bnr_yml.ado` and `bnr_workbook.ado`. |
| Briefing analysis | [`briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence.do`](briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence.do) | Calculates annual CVD incidence and rate-ratio outputs from the approved Step 3 metric-input dataset and creates a complete private staging package for review. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly `bnr_yml.ado` and `bnr_workbook.ado`. |
| Briefing analysis | [`briefings/cvd_length_of_stay/cvd_length_of_stay.do`](briefings/cvd_length_of_stay/cvd_length_of_stay.do) | Calculates annual CVD length-of-stay and bed-demand outputs from the approved Step 3 metric-input dataset and creates a complete private staging package for review. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly `bnr_yml.ado` and `bnr_workbook.ado`. |
| Common briefing helper | [`common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`](common/bnr_stage_briefing.do) | Applies the common briefing packaging contract at the end of an analyst build: validates staged outputs, writes metadata and review material, builds the workbook and ZIP, and leaves the package in private staging. It does not approve or publish. | `ado/bnr_yml.ado`; `ado/bnr_workbook.ado`. |
| Common metric helper | [`common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do`](common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do) | Validates and packages unsuppressed metric outputs and their QA material in private Step 4 staging. | None. |
| Common metric helper | [`common/bnr_step5_suppress.do`](common/bnr_step5_suppress.do) | Applies the metrics disclosure-control rules and creates the public-ready candidate and suppression-review material used by Metrics Step 5. | None. |
| Common configuration | [`common/bnrcvd_globals.do`](common/bnrcvd_globals.do) | Defines shared run metadata, compatibility aliases and CVD display constants. It does not define machine-specific project paths. | None. |
| Local configuration | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` | Defines the machine-specific public repository, private repository, staging, log, token and ADO paths used by local Stata runs. This file remains untracked. | None. Created from `bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do`. |
| Configuration template | [`config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do`](config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do) | Version-controlled template used to create `bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` on a workstation. | None. |
| Menu | [`menu/bnr_menu.do`](menu/bnr_menu.do) | Adds the current Metrics, Briefings and Tables dialog entry points to Stata's **User** menu. | No DO/ADO dependency; opens the matching files under `dialogs/`. |
| Metrics Step 1 | [`monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do`](monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do) | Extracts the selected cumulative CVD REDCap release and writes the private raw CSV, Stata dataset, extraction manifest and log. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Metrics Step 2 | [`monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do`](monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do) | Joins the selected REDCap release to the invariant historical data, reconciles the sources, and writes the confidential cumulative CVD dataset and QA outputs. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Metrics Step 3 | [`monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do`](monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do) | Creates authorised, deidentified input datasets for counts, incidence, case-fatality, length-of-stay and the combined all-variables product. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Metrics Step 4 | [`monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do`](monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do) | Controls calculation of the selected metric family and creation of its private unsuppressed staging package. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do`; `common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do`. |
| Metric analysis | [`metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do`](metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do) | Calculates the current CVD burden metrics, including registered event counts and event distributions, and returns the standard long-format dataset and QA results to the Step 4 controller. | None; receives its run contract from `monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do`. |
| Metrics Step 5 | [`monthly/bnr_step5_review.do`](monthly/bnr_step5_review.do) | Runs the deliberately separate prepare and approve actions: creates a suppressed public-ready candidate for human review, then records approval and writes the public manifest. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnr_step5_suppress.do`. |
| Metrics Step 6 | [`monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do`](monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do) | Checks the approval receipt and manifest, promotes approved metric files to the public output tree, and refreshes the website mirror. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Tables Step 1 | [`tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables.do`](tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables.do) | Calculates the private unsuppressed CVD tabulation datasets and workbook from the approved all-variables Step 3 input. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Tables Step 2A | [`tables/bnr_step2a_cvd_tables.do`](tables/bnr_step2a_cvd_tables.do) | Applies primary and secondary suppression, creates public-ready table files, and writes the disclosure-review material. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Tables Step 2B | [`tables/bnr_step2b_cvd_tables_approve.do`](tables/bnr_step2b_cvd_tables_approve.do) | Validates the reviewed table package and records approval without publishing it. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |
| Tables Step 3 | [`tables/bnr_step3_cvd_tables_publish.do`](tables/bnr_step3_cvd_tables_publish.do) | Validates the approved table package and manifest, promotes the 26 required files, refreshes the site mirror, and creates the stable download ZIP. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. |

## Validation, migration and non-routine support

These files are not part of routine monthly operations. They are retained as technical evidence or controlled examples.

| Area | File | Responsibility | Stata dependencies |
|:-----|:-----|:---------------|:-------------------|
| Ad-hoc briefing test | [`briefings/ad-hoc/cvd_ad_hoc_workflow_test_2026_v1.do`](briefings/ad-hoc/cvd_ad_hoc_workflow_test_2026_v1.do) | Exercises the ad-hoc branch of the current briefing staging contract. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly `bnr_yml.ado` and `bnr_workbook.ado`. |
| Case-fatality validation | [`briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality_equivalence_check.do`](briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality_equivalence_check.do) | One-time comparison used to verify that the migrated case-fatality analysis reproduces the accepted historical results. | None; compares retained data products. |
| Incidence validation | [`briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence_equivalence_check.do`](briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence_equivalence_check.do) | One-time comparison used to verify that the migrated incidence analysis reproduces the accepted historical results. | None; compares retained data products. |
| Case-count migration | [`briefings/cvd_cases_2023/cvd_cases_2023_v2.do`](briefings/cvd_cases_2023/cvd_cases_2023_v2.do) | Frozen migration pilot showing how the former case-count briefing used a Step 3 input and the current briefing staging helper. Case counts are no longer an operational briefing product. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly `bnr_yml.ado` and `bnr_workbook.ado`. |
| Case-count validation | [`briefings/cvd_cases_2023/cvd_cases_2023_v2_equivalence_check.do`](briefings/cvd_cases_2023/cvd_cases_2023_v2_equivalence_check.do) | One-time equivalence test supporting the case-count v2 migration pilot. | None; compares retained historical and migrated products. |
| Tables validation | [`tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables_regression.do`](tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables_regression.do) | One-time regression comparison between the accepted source workbook and the Tables Step 1 outputs. | None; consumes retained comparison products. |

Case counts are now covered by dashboards. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnrcvd_prep_2023_v1.do`; `common/bnr_publish_briefing.do`. |
| Historical preparation | [`common/bnrcvd_prep_2023_v1.do`](common/bnrcvd_prep_2023_v1.do) | Converts the frozen cumulative 2009–2023 CVD source into the historical analysis datasets used by the old annual tables and v1 case-count workflows. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `ado/bnr_yml.ado`. |
| Historical publisher | [`common/bnr_publish_briefing.do`](common/bnr_publish_briefing.do) | Performs the earlier combined briefing packaging, publication and site-mirroring process. | `ado/bnr_yml.ado`; `ado/bnr_workbook.ado`; `common/mirror_public_to_site.do`. |

## Files not listed separately

- `.dlg` files provide Stata dialog interfaces; they do not perform analysis.
- `.sthlp` files provide Stata help and are not executable code.
- `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` is listed for operational clarity but should remain untracked.
- Files already under `docs/holding-bay/stata-legacy/` are outside the live `scripts/stata/` inventory.
- Filenames containing `copy` and `refit/bnrcvd-2023-forensics2_original.do` are excluded because they are superseded copies rather than maintained code.

Movement or deletion of non-operational files should follow the controlled cleanup register and be followed by current workflow checks and a full Quarto render.
